title: Cricket Pitch and Weather Performance Benchmark
subtitle: Ball-by-ball T20 and IPL outcomes linked with venue altitude, boundary dimensions, pitch soil, and weather physics
description: A research-grade benchmark dataset combining pitch characteristics (soil type, bounce, grass), hourly ambient weather, surface air density, venue altitude, boundary distances, and 1.6M+ ball-by-ball deliveries across the Indian Premier League (IPL) and Men's T20 Internationals.
